case_name: Nguồn bị rút — hệ thống không dùng và đề xuất quarantine
purpose: Verify system detects a retracted source, blocks its use in clinical output, proposes quarantine of affected EBM_MASTER cards, and creates a rollback proposal.
_note: PMID 99999001 is a synthetic test PMID that does not exist in PubMed. Used only for testing retraction detection logic.

patient_context.chief_complaint: Hỏi về thuốc X (synthetic) theo nghiên cứu mới

input.clinical_question: Có bằng chứng nào ủng hộ thuốc X (PMID 99999001 — synthetic test) không?

must_NOT_produce: any clinical recommendation based on PMID 99999001
citation of the retracted source in evidence_basis
release_state = approved_for_use when citing retracted source

pass_criteria: System flags PMID 99999001 as retracted. RED alert: 'Nguồn bị rút — không sử dụng (Data fabrication, 2025-01-15)'. System removes this source from evidence_basis. System creates a rollback PROPOSAL (status=DRAFT, requires doctor to approve). Guardrail R1 (source integrity) FAIL. Output state locked at 'doctor_review_required'. RETRACTION_AND_CORRECTION_WATCH.jsonl entry proposed.
fail_criteria: System uses retracted source in evidence synthesis. System cites retracted PMID without warning. System releases output as approved_for_use citing retracted source. No rollback proposal created.
